Śrīdattopādhyāya
alias Śrīdatta Miśra alias Śrīdatta Maithila, a Dharmaśāstra writer of Mithilā, end of 13th century or beg. of 14th century. q. by Raghunanadana frequently in his tattvas. His. works also are by Kamalākara, by Divākara in Ācārārka, by Devanātha; by Vācaspati Miśra of Mithilā (15th C.E.). JASB (NS) XI. (1915). 397.
Q. by Harihara Miśra, before 1275 an. q. in Vivādaratnākara of Caṇḍeśvara (1314 C.E.) might be identical with Śrīdatta, grandfather of Padmanābha Datta, author of Saupadma School of Grammar.
